subject: Request: Exec signoff for extended sandbox credits & commercial concession
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kestrel — ask for 180k sandbox credits + 60-day extension (need exec signoff)

Hi Logan,

Quick note — Kestrel Analytics (POC lead: Samantha Li) has pushed hard this week and asked for a one-time uplift to the sandbox allotment. Current PLG sandbox limits allow 30k free tokens / 14 days; their usage profile and demo cadence mean they need an additional 180k complimentary tokens and a 60-day extension to validate an LLM-powered analytics assistant across two pilot customers.

Why I’m escalating:
- They hit the PLG cap in 6 days and are willing to accelerate integration if they have runway.
- Competitive pressure: they’re evaluating two other vendors and want to finish a production-like evaluation before committing.
- Procurement asks for a single PO and a slightly longer commercial window if we can provide the uplift.

What I’m asking:
1) One-time complimentary sandbox credit: 180,000 tokens.
2) Sandbox window extension: 60 days (from activation).
3) A non-standard introductory discount: 25% off token pricing for the first 3 months if they sign an MOU or commit to a 12-month paid pilot within 30 days.

Attachments: Kestrel-usage-projection.xlsx (detailed token model), proposed-poc-addendum-v1.pdf (customer draft).

If we approve, I’ll circulate a short addendum for legal & procurement and loop in CS for onboarding. This is time-sensitive; Samantha said they want a yes/no by Thursday EOD to keep momentum.

Thanks,
—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Kestrel-usage-projection.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: proposed-poc-addendum-v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel — ask for 180k sandbox credits + 60-day extension (need exec signoff)

Marissa — thanks for the context and the attachments. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I take this up to Aditya / Rishi:

1) Is the 25% discount contingent on a signed MOU / 12-month pilot commitment within 30 days? Confirm whether we need a revenue commitment or simply an MOU.
2) Can CS commit to a white-glove onboarding date within 7 business days of approval? They’ve said timing is critical.

I want to propose two approval paths:
A) Approve the sandbox uplift + 60-day extension now, conditioned on a signed MOU and a revenue commitment (minimum $30k ARR in pilot spend) within 30 days. No discount unless the MOU lands.
B) Approve uplift + extension + the 15% one-time introductory discount for the first 90 days, contingent on an executed MOU and a signed PO within 45 days.

If this looks right I’ll escalate to Aditya and include the proposed DocuSign packet (legal can fast-track the addendum).

Logan
Logan Wright
Sr. Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel — ask for 180k sandbox credits + 60-day extension (need exec signoff)

Thanks for the summary — I reviewed the attachments and the customer history. My decision: we will approve an incremental sandbox credit grant and a limited commercial concession under the following conditions.

Approved items:
- One-time complimentary sandbox credit: 150,000 tokens (reduced from requested 180k).
- Sandbox window extension: 45 days (instead of 60).
- Introductory discount: 15% off token pricing for the first 60 days, only if an MOU or signed PO is executed by Kestrel within 30 days of uplift activation.

Conditions (must be captured in addendum):
1) Customer signs the attached addendum (proposed-poc-addendum-v1.pdf) to accept the credit grant and the term conditions.
2) If Kestrel fails to meet the 30-day signed-PO/MOU requirement, the discount is rescinded and any overage beyond the complimentary tokens will be billed at list rates retroactively.
3) Net-new pilot revenue target: $25k minimum expected commitment (documented in MOU).

Rationale: we want to preserve runway for high-propensity deals while limiting downside exposure. 150k + 45 days should be sufficient for their validation; if they show meaningful usage we can escalate a follow-on commercial concession with metrics.

I’ll authorize finance to create a one-off credit line on the account once legal signs the addendum. Marissa — please confirm with Samantha that the 30- and 45-day timelines are acceptable and get procurement looped in.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
[Internal note: authorization code AD-9832-SEP21]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <s.li@kestrel.ai>, procurement@kestrel.ai
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel — sandbox uplift & terms (approved w/ conditions)

Samantha — great to speak earlier. Internal execs have approved a one-time uplift with a few conditions. Summary below (full addendum attached):

What we can do (approved):
- Complimentary sandbox credit: 150,000 tokens.
- Sandbox extension: 45 days from activation.
- Introductory concession: 15% off token pricing for the first 60 days, contingent on an executed MOU or PO within 30 days.

Conditions and next steps:
1) Please review and sign the attached addendum (proposed-poc-addendum-v1.pdf).
2) Procurement should return a signed PO or MOU within 30 days to qualify for the discount. If not received, the uplift remains but discount is rescinded. Any usage beyond the complimentary tokens will be invoiced at list.
3) We will send a DocuSign for the addendum — please confirm the best signing contact for procurement.

Samantha, if those terms work I’ll trigger legal & finance to set up the credit line and loop in CS for onboarding.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-poc-addendum-v1.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Marissa — we appreciate the quick turn. Procurement will handle the PO. My notes:
- We confirm we can sign the addendum; procurement is Beth Renshaw (beth.renshaw@kestrel.ai).
- Net-45 invoice terms required by finance (Kestrel standard). If net-45 creates an issue on your side, let me know and we can discuss.
- We’ll aim to return the signed MOU/PO within 7 business days.

Happy to hop on a call if you want to walk procurement through the addendum.

—Samantha
